digest.component_or_area: CI/CD: dependency updates and vulnerability fixes
propositions: Dependabot PRs #123 (actions bumps) and #124 (mcp 2.0 + ruff 0.16.1) must be landed as Gerrit changes because GitHub is a read-only mirror and PRs cannot merge there directly.
A P0 click 8.2.1 vulnerability (PYSEC-2026-2132, command injection) blocks all CI until fixed to 8.3.3 in uv.lock, requiring a Change 0 that lands first before other changes.
PR #123 applies 13 workflow files with setup-python v6 → v7 and pypi-publish re-pin; the Verified CI run on the Gerrit change validates the v7 migration functionally.

PR #124 bumps mcp 1.29.0 → 2.0.0 (major) and ruff 0.15.22 → 0.16.1; mcp v1 API paths used in mcp_server.py, _mcp_auth.py, and _mcp_models.py must be verified for backward-compatibility shims or deferred if breaking.

The mcp constraint `>=1.28.1,<2` exists in two external locations (.github/workflows/_optionality.yml:105 and ADR 0050) that must stay coherent with the pyproject.toml bump; Path 1 updates both to `<3`, Path 2 defers mcp v2 and retains `<2`.
